title: System Engineer, Behavioral Analysis
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin Texas or New York</strong></p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare One brings together secure access, network connectivity, and data protection. Our products generate massive amounts of signals about how people and agents access applications, use the network, and handle data—but a security practitioner needs more than isolated events. They need to understand what happened, whether it is unusual, why it matters, and what to investigate next.</p> <p>The UEBA (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) team builds the systems behind those answers. We ingest and evaluate Cloudflare One signals, produce high fidelity user-risk events, maintain risk scores, and make that information available to customer-facing experiences and other Cloudflare services. Today, we are focused on expanding our behavioral detections and improving the clarity of the resulting investigations and integrations.</p> <p>As a Systems Engineer, you will build and operate production services in this pipeline. You might implement a detection for an unusual pattern of DNS activity or data movement, improve how events contribute to a user’s risk score, or make risk-event history easier for customers to investigate. You will own well-defined projects through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operational follow-through, working with other engineers, Product, and partner teams across Cloudflare.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build behavioral detections</strong>. Turn product requirements and available telemetry into production-ready detections across signals such as Access, Gateway, DNS, device posture, and data protection. Define the data dependencies, evaluation approach, and how you will assess signal quality before release.</li> <li><strong>Make risk understandable</strong>. Help connect detection output to event history, logs, and customer-facing investigations so practitioners can see what triggered a finding and how a user’s risk changed.</li> <li><strong>Design & Scale Infrastructure</strong>: Architect, deploy, and maintain robust distributed systems, focusing on high availability, low latency, and horizontal scalability.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams</strong>. Collaborate with Product and engineers in Access, Gateway, Analytics and Reporting, Logs, and other data-producing or data-consuming teams to agree on event contracts and deliver end-to-end functionality.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Reliability</strong>. Participate in architecture reviews, capacity planning, and proactive system health monitoring to guarantee maximum uptime and resilience.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional experience building, testing, and operating backend or distributed systems in production.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in at least one systems programming language (e.g., Go, Rust, C/C++) with a track record of writing clean, maintainable code.</li> <li>3+ years of practical experience with databases and data-intensive services—for example, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or comparable relational or analytical stores.</li> <li>Experience reasoning about event-driven systems: message delivery, duplicate or late events, state, failure recovery, and safe changes to live consumers or APIs.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, and an ability to work through technical decisions with product and engineering partners.</li> <li>Experience using metrics, logs, traces, profiling, and experiments to understand production behavior and validate improvements</li> <li>Bring strong opinions, clear judgment, and a willingness to revise your view when data, users, or production reality prove otherwise.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with security analytics, fraud or abuse detection, identity, Zero Trust, SASE, or network telemetry.</li> <li>Familiarity with Kafka or other streaming systems; Kubernetes; and high-volume event processing.</li> <li>Experience with statistical baselines, anomaly detection, time-windowed aggregation, or evaluating false positives and detection coverage.</li> <li>Familiarity with DNS, HTTP, authentication events, data-loss-prevention signals, or endpoint-security integrations.</li> <li>Experience with distributed state, caches, object storage, or safe migration of a legacy production service.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>New York Estimated Base salary $150,000 - $206,000.</p> <p>Austin Texas Estimated Base salary $136,000 - $187,000.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Influencer Marketing Manager | Mid | French Market
description: The world’s most advanced VPN, and a whole lot more. If you’re a curious problem-solver who carves their own path, join the team behind Threat Protection Pro, the NordLynx protocol, and the fastest VPN on the planet—tools that put privacy, security, and control back in people’s hands. Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data. Influencer Marketing team is a fast-moving, data-driven group of campaign strategists, creator partnerships managers, and performance marketers. We're driving cultural relevance and growth across our cybersecurity suite products, such as NordVPN, Saily, Coveron and other brands. We’re looking for a dynamic Influencer Marketing Manager to drive influencer campaigns, with a strong focus on YouTube. This is a performance-driven role where ROAS is the primary KPI. You’ll own a monthly revenue target, have full visibility into your results, and directly impact marketing performance in a team where strong results are recognized and rewarded. Main Responsibilities Own a quarterly billings target and consistently hit or exceed it through effective campaign planning and execution. Build and maintain creator relationships across YouTube, Instagram, and other social media platforms. Identify and engage new influencers, respond to inbound leads, and negotiate rates and terms to maximize ROI and billings. Run paid social campaigns using influencer-generated content (IGC), including whitelisting, dark posting, and performance optimization. Track your pipeline and revenue performance weekly, owning your results and learning from performance. Manage campaign operations, including reporting, invoicing, budget tracking, and performance analytics. Explore growth opportunities through market research, new market strategies, industry trends, and creative campaign ideas. Collaborate with the wider marketing team to align influencer strategies across channels. Core Requirements Strong understanding of digital marketing with a focus on influencer marketing. Results-driven mindset — you're motivated by targets, and measurable outcomes are what drive you. Previous experience owning a revenue, billings, or sales KPI is a strong plus. Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to close deals and drive revenue. Ability to analyze data and present the results. Proven track record with YouTube/Instagram campaigns, including hands-on experience managing influencer collaborations. Fluent in English and Italian. You stay up-to-date with YouTube's/Instagram's top creators and can name a few favorites. What We Offer Sharpen your edge: training, mentorship, and room to grow — always. Take the time you need: extra vacation days, sick days, and time off when life calls. Get premium healthcare: private health insurance in Lithuania and Poland — fully covered. Protect your peace: enjoy free subscriptions to Calm, Headspace, and Mindletic, and our own resilience and mindfulness trainings. Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us. Pack your bags for workation: experience our company-wide trip abroad to the fullest. Work from anywhere: work from wherever keeps you in the zone. Celebrate your milestones: birthdays, weddings, and new family members — all deserve a gift. Parent with ease: children’s summer camps and flexibility around the schedule — because parenting never pauses. Join the party: team building and company events people talk about for months. Unlock Cyber City: coffee bar, open gyms, kids’ room, music room, massage chairs — our Vilnius HQ is yours to enjoy. title: People & Talent Lead
description: Remote from France or Germany · Full-time Become Kestra’s first dedicated People hire. Help us grow from 50 to 100 people over the next 12 to 18 months, and strengthen the foundations that help a distributed team work well together. You will own recruitment and People operations, working directly with the founders and hiring managers. This is a hands-on role with room to shape the function as we grow. Reporting to: Emmanuel (CEO) and Ludovic (CTO), our co-founders Working language: English Why Kestra Orchestrate everything, everywhere. From one control plane. Data, infrastructure, business processes and AI agents. Build, run and govern them all, in the cloud or on your own servers. AI agents follow the same rules as everything else. We believe orchestration is becoming a shared layer of enterprise architecture: the layer that coordinates what runs across tools, teams and environments. Kestra is building that foundation as an open-source platform, giving enterprises a common way to manage increasingly complex automation. Founded in France, we are growing our enterprise business in Europe and the United States. In March 2026, we raised a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with Alven, ISAI and Axeleo. Teams at JPMorgan Chase, Apple, TotalEnergies, Crédit Agricole, Leroy Merlin, Bloomberg and Deutsche Telekom run Kestra in production. The opportunity Our next stage depends on bringing in the right people and helping them succeed. We are hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing and Customer Operations, with substantial growth planned across functions and all the regions where we operate. You will bring dedicated People and Talent leadership to an established organisation, working with the founders, hiring managers and the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already support our People processes. With colleagues across more than ten countries and many recent joiners, the work goes beyond hiring. People need a good start, clear expectations and connections across teams. You will help make that experience consistent as we grow. What you will own Recruitment from sourcing to signed offer. Find and engage candidates, run initial conversations, coordinate focused interview processes and keep the ATS reliable. Work with the founders and leaders across functions to prioritise roles and help hiring managers make well-supported decisions. People operations across countries. Work with our Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams to coordinate contracts, payroll partners, EOR providers, benefits, time off and employee requests. Keep records and deadlines clear, and work with local providers and advisers on employment requirements. Onboarding that gets people started well. Make the practical setup smooth and help managers give new joiners clear expectations, useful context and the right relationships from day one. Compensation and performance processes. Develop the framework with the founders, then run the cycles: salary reviews, levels, performance reviews and equity administration, including BSPCE where applicable. How we work as a distributed team. Organise all-hands and the company offsite, strengthen internal communication and build routines that help people collaborate across locations. A clear view of progress. Give the founders useful information on hiring, headcount and employment costs. Use it to identify bottlenecks and decide what needs attention. What you bring Experience combining People and Talent in a growing company. You have worked through a period of significant hiring and know which processes become necessary as a team grows. Recruitment experience you have built yourself. You have sourced candidates, assessed them with hiring managers and closed offers. You can explain the difficult searches, the hires that worked and what you learned from those that did not. Experience recruiting across functions. You have hired technical and business profiles, understand how to adapt your approach to different roles and markets, and work with managers to assess evidence of performance beyond a convincing interview. Practical knowledge of international employment. You have worked with EOR providers, payroll partners and local advisers, and know when a situation needs specialist input. Strong operational judgment. You are comfortable in an ATS, HRIS and payroll platforms, handle sensitive information carefully and follow through on details. The ability to build and operate. You can introduce a useful process, run it yourself and improve it without adding unnecessary complexity. Fluent professional English. French or German is useful for working with local employees and providers. Experience in developer tools or open source, a background in operations or consulting, or experience supporting US employment from Europe would be valuable. How you will work You will build on an established organisation, supported by the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already carry our People processes. Your role is to bring dedicated expertise, coordinate this work and help it scale as the company grows. We already use Kestra to automate business and administrative workflows, improving them as our needs evolve. You will continue this approach with the teams involved: simplify processes, automate repetitive work and keep human attention where it matters. Managers remain responsible for their hiring decisions and teams. You will guide them, challenge them when necessary and agree priorities with the founders as recruitment and employee needs evolve. What we offer Compensation discussed in the first conversation, based on the scope and level of the role rather than your current salary. Equity participation, through BSPCE where applicable. Remote work from France or Germany, with flexibility around team commitments. An annual company offsite. Equipment, conference and training budgets, with time to learn. Direct access to the founders and the opportunity to build a function that grows with the company. How we hire 45 minutes with Emmanuel and Ludovic: the role, your experience and your questions. 60 minutes on your work: a hiring process you ran end to end and a complex international People situation you resolved. 45 minutes with two future colleagues: one from the commercial team and one from the technical team. Three conversations, no take-home exercise, and a decision within two weeks of the first call. Send your CV or LinkedIn profile. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The role will focus on creating secure and scalable processes to connect operational systems, unstructured project documentation and data from third-party platforms into existing data warehousing infrastructure.</p> <p>The successful candidate will help transform fragmented agency knowledge into governed, searchable, AI-ready assets while ensuring adherence to privacy, retention, and client-specific data requirements.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create a structured data layer to integrate and model structured data from API enabled sources such as CRM systems, Azure databases, event attendance systems, survey platforms, and financial warehouses.</li> <li>Create ingestion pipelines for the unstructured knowledge layer that includes Powerpoint presentations, Word documents and unstructured Excel spreadsheets.</li> <li>Build an AI-Ready document infrastructure that can classify documents, handle versioning, track provenance, and manage metadata, auditability and permissioning.</li> <li>Implement frameworks for strictest confidentiality and privacy protections, including access controls and security roles, consent tracking, data retention and data deletion management.</li> <li>Work with members of the Jack Morton team to clearly communicate limitations, timeline expectations, out-of-pocket cost expectations and repercussions to platform design.</li> <li>Participate in planning discussions on platform roadmap with Jack Morton team members.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Data engineering requirements</strong></p> <p><em>Pipeline design, ingestion, schema, data quality, orchestration, tooling.</em></p> <p>This role requires strong experience in the following:</p> <ul> <li>Python</li> <li>SQL</li> <li>Data Modeling</li> <li>Data Warehousing (Snowflake experience is desirable)</li> <li>ETL or ELT development</li> <li>API Integrations</li> <li>Batch and event-driven pipelines.</li> </ul> <p>The applicant should understand:</p> <ul> <li>Metadata extraction</li> <li>OCR workflows</li> <li>Semantic indexing</li> <li>Vector databases</li> <li>Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)</li> <li>Chunking strategies</li> <li>Document classification</li> <li>Embedding pipelines</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Security requirements</strong></p> <p><em>Access control, tenant isolation, key management, pseudonymisation, audit and logging, compliance frameworks.</em></p> <p>Experience with the following is essential, with AI-specific experience being a bonus:</p> <ul> <li>PII handling and understanding of GDPR implications</li> <li>Data pseudonymization</li> <li>Data lineage</li> <li>Retention policies</li> <li>Audit logging</li> <li>Data access controls</li> </ul> <p><strong>Platform and tooling</strong></p> <p><em>Snowflake, AWS, Bedrock, integration patterns, languages, infrastructure as code.</em></p> <ul> <li>Snowflake</li> <li>AWS Cognito</li> <li>AWS S3</li> <li>AWS Lamda</li> <li>AWS DynamoDB</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Azure or Snowflake data warehousing</li> <li>Document ingestion and RAG experience</li> <li>Data governance and security</li> <li>Modern data modeling skills</li> <li>API integration</li> <li>Data pipelines for unstructured documentation</li> <li>Experience explaining technical infrastructure to non-technical teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience preferred</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>LLM model building</li> <li>Understanding of event and experiential marketing</li> <li>Experience working with a project-based business</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>First 90 days</strong></p> <p><em>What success looks like by day 30, 60 and 90.</em></p> <p>Within title: Principal Oracle Procurement Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>Job Title </strong></p> <p>Oracle Procurement Lead</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>The Oracle Procurement Lead is a key Architect responsible for driving the strategy, solution architecture and execution of our global procurement technology ecosystem. Our architecture leverages Oracle Fusion Cloud as our procurement and financial system of record with Zip as the orchestration layer.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is a Procurement technologist and architect who understands the nuances of the entire ERP Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between user-centric intake and rigorous financial controls, ensuring that complex business requirements from Legal, Finance, and Global Sourcing are translated into seamless, automated workflows that maintain data integrity across both Zip and Oracle</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Solution Architecture:</strong> Define and maintain the long-term technical architecture for the procurement ecosystem, ensuring system scalability, security, and seamless interoperability between Zip and Oracle Fusion.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Process Architecture:</strong> Design and optimize the global S2P process, ensuring a frictionless hand-off between upstream sourcing/intake and downstream purchasing/payables (Oracle Fusion).</li> <li><strong>Platform Configuration:</strong> Act as the functional lead for Oracle Fusion Procurement. Build complex intake workflows and configure Requisitioning, Purchasing, and Supplier Portals in Oracle to match.</li> <li><strong>Integration Ecosystem Management:</strong> Own the functional health of the Oracle procurement systems integration. Monitor data flow for Requisitions, Purchase Orders, and Supplier Master Data, Compliance screening, ensuring that "In-Flight" changes in one system are accurately reflected in the other.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Business Partnership:</strong> Lead discovery sessions with Global Procurement, Legal, and Accounting. Translate high-level business policies  into precise logic within the tech stack.</li> <li><strong>Data Governance & Compliance:</strong> Ensure that the "System of Record" (Oracle) remains audit-ready. Manage the mapping of Category Codes, Cost Centers, and Tax attributes between the Zip and the Oracle GL.</li> <li><strong>Release Management:</strong> Manage the quarterly update cycles for Oracle. Conduct impact assessments on new features to ensure no disruption to the integrated workflow.</li> <li><strong>AI Procurement Agent Strategy & Governance:</strong> Lead the adoption and functional governance of Oracle's embedded and custom AI agents (e.g., Procurement Policy Advisor), ensuring all AI-driven automation and outputs within the S2P process are compliant, auditable, and drive process efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Oracle Fusion Lifecycle Management:</strong> Oversee the full lifecycle management within Oracle Fusion, including requisitioning, purchase orders, receipts, and invoice matching to ensure accurate financial reporting and spend visibility.</li> <li><strong>Oracle Fusion Supplier & Trade Configuration:</strong> Configure and maintain Oracle Fusion supplier master data, trade management workflows, and complex approval hierarchies to support global procurement needs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements </strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years<strong> </strong>of hands-on experience in Oracle Procurement (Self-Service Procurement, Sourcing, Purchasing, Supplier Model, Contracts). </li> <li>5+ years of experience in Oracle Fusion Procurement.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle, including PR/PO lifecycle, Accounting, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM).</li> <li>Proven experience managing API-based integrations between Intake-to-Procure tools and Tier-1 ERPs. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 18 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das bewegst du:</h2> <p>Als <strong>Werkstudent (Mensch) Media Audit & Value Management</strong> unterstützt du uns im operativen Tagesgeschäft dabei, die Mediainvestitionen unserer Kunden transparent und nachvollziehbar abzubilden. Dabei werden Werbeschaltungen und Mediainvestitionen systematisch erfasst und aufbereitet.</li> <li class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Reporting & Datenanalyse:</strong> Die Analyse relevanter Daten und KPIs hilft dabei, Abweichungen zu erkennen und die Ergebnisse als Grundlage für weitere Auswertungen und Entscheidungen aufzubereiten.</li> <li><strong>Teamwork & Schnittstellen:</strong> In enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen internen Teams und Stakeholdern sorgst du dafür, dass Informationen und Daten korrekt zusammengeführt werden.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das zeichnet dich aus:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Studium & Verfügbarkeit:</strong> Als eingeschriebene/r Student/in studierst du vorzugsweise Medienmanagement, BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest uns mindestens 1,5 Jahre mit 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen.</li> <li><strong>Analytisches Verständnis:</strong> Deine Begeisterung für Zahlen und Daten sowie dein ausgeprägtes analytisches Verständnis zeichnen dich aus.</li> <li><strong>MS Excel & Arbeitsweise:</strong> Gute, praxiserprobte MS-Excel-Kenntnisse, eine strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise sowie Eigenverantwortlichkeit gehören zu deinen Stärken.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On & Kommunikation:</strong> Eine pragmatische Hands-On-Mentalität und sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch runden dein Profil ab.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #AnalytischesDenken #HandsOnMentalität #Teamwork</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Platform)

advertisers using Smartly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Here's What We're Looking For...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>We’re seeking an experienced Software Engineer with Strong Python skills</li> <li>5+ years of <li>Hybrid Workplace: Experience the flexibility of a hybrid work model, balancing office and remote work, with the option to work abroad for up to 30 days.</li> </ul> <p>Smartly is committed to being title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ad Performance Recommendation
description: <p>We are seeking a<strong> Senior Engineering Manager</strong> to join our 200+ product development organization and lead our<strong> Ad Performance Recommendation team</strong>. The team ensures compliance with privacy, security, and ethical guidelines.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to define the vision and strategy for ML and Data Science applications, drive execution on ambitious goals, and champion AI and ML excellence throughout Smartly.</p> <p>Smartly is proud to be ranked as a leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Creative AdTech. This recognition reflects our commitment to transforming ad experiences through intelligent creativity, standing as the only platform honored by both Forrester and validated by PwC to be recognized for ad technology to power performance.</p> <p>To get an idea of some of the work we do, see for example these blog posts:</p> <p><a href="https://www.smartly.io/blog/tutorial-how-we-productized-bayesian-revenue-estimation-with-stan">How We Productized Bayesian Revenue Estimation with Stan</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.smartly.io/blog/optimizing-conversions-with-predictive-budget-allocation">Optimizing Conversions with Predictive Budget Allocation</a></p> <p><strong>Here’s What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and grow the Ad Performance Recommendation team, providing technical direction, strategic vision, and hands-on leadership.</li> <li>Drive the development of AdTech-specific ML models foundational AI capabilities (e.g. predictive and simulation techniques) and explore novel approaches that can be applied across Smartly’s products. title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Benefits Wir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen Die Möglichkeit, unseren Tech-Stack aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 28 Tage Urlaub Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt Deine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln. title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products . Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems . Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting . German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. A thoughtful hiring process : We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in Germany. You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference. Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments. You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices. The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels. You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers. Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems. Accountabilities Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization. Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability. Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates. Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions. Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations. Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL). Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding. Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads. Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications. Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies. Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability. Requirements: Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences. Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch. Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices. Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications. Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment. Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones. Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware. Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges. Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems. Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters. Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers. Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions. Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams. Benefits: Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference. Remote-first working environment with an international team. Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges. Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications. Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering. Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems. Access to challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, inference engines, memory optimization, and distributed computing. description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.<br><br>We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. platforms through their entire product life-cycle.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Own customer success through the design and delivery of a multi-year, multi-stakeholder software roadmap that multi-stakeholder environment including engineering, business and sales leadership.</li> <li>Drive the design and implementation of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of software, including full lifecycle testing</li> <li>Drive the creation of test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop</li> <li>Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment</li> <li>Lead teams of multi-disciplinary engineers, including as a mentor for Senior Software Engineers from differing backgrounds</li> <li>Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time</li> </ul> <h3>Required Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Experience in a leadership position within a high performing technology organization</li> <li>Extensive professional experience working as a Software Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise</li> <li>Systems and/or application programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, scaling, testing, infrastructure, software design and system design</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems</li> <li>Capacity to work holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment</li> <li>Capacity to act as the technical owner for an entire software system, including stakeholder frontend applications using Typescript and React</li> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and operation of horizontally scaled cloud technologies</li> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and support of embedded software, particularly in the field of robotics</li> <li>Experience with modeling and simulation</li> <li>Experience with development of high assurance safety critical software</li> <li>Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Systems Engineering concepts</li> <li>Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Staff Software Engineer, such as Principal Software Engineer and/or Senior Manager, Software Engineering</li> Test software ships through pipelines, not over USB sticks. Stand it up, maintain it, hold the line on review and version control.</li> <li>Integration with Anduril's factory systems: MES (work instructions, routings, defect capture), Oracle ERP, Teamcenter PLM where relevant. Test results should land in the systems where they're traced and acted on, not in spreadsheets.</li> <li>Technician-facing usability. GUIs that lower the entry-skill bar. Curated, version-controlled tests. Clear pass/fail. Helpful error codes that point at the actual problem, not at a stack trace.</li> <li>Cross-site codebase convergence with other Anduril production sites. You're part of converging the AU and US Manufacturing Test stacks — shared framework, shared XL Utility code, common error-code library. You'll work with the US team to make that real.</li> <li>Floor support. When a test fails and it's not clear whether it's the product, the tester, or the test code — you debug it. You're the one called when the GUI throws an unexpected error and the build's stopped.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineering fundamentals. Python first, with real experience building, maintaining, and debugging test frameworks — not just scripts. You write code other people can read, change, and ship.</li> <li>Linux + command line as a primary environment. You live in a shell. You write Bash where it makes sense. You're comfortable with system-level configuration, process management, and network debugging — not as a special skill, just as how you work.</li> <li>Hardware-software interface fluency. You've written software that drives test instruments and hardware-under-test through real interfaces — USB, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, CAN, I2C, SPI, GPIB, or equivalent.</li> <li>Electronics troubleshooting hands-on. You don't escalate the question — you get hands on and answer it.</li> <li>GUI development experience. You've built user-facing test consoles or operator interfaces — frameworks vary (PyQt, Tkinter, web stacks, LabVIEW front panels) but you understand what makes a tech-facing GUI usable vs frustrating, and you can ship one.</li> <li>Software-engineering discipline. You version-control test code. You write tests for the test code where it matters. You think about reproducibility, configuration management, and rollback before they bite.</li> <li>Bias to action and ownership. You see a fragmented toolchain and your reaction is to fix it, not to log a ticket. You're comfortable being the one who decides what the framework looks like.</li> <li>Clearance eligibility. Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Production test environments — not just R&D test benches. Building software that has to survive a production floor, technicians under time pressure, and shift handovers is its own discipline.</li> <li>NixOS or other declarative-configuration systems (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). The target is NixOS; coachable from any solid declarative-config background.</li> <li>Test frameworks like LabVIEW, TestStand, pytest-based test harnesses, or equivalent — exposure to more than one is a plus.</li> <li>Experience working with — or building toward — common test metrics: first-pass yield, false-fail rate, tester utilisation, GR&R, test coverage.</li> <li>MES (Solumina, Ae), ERP (Oracle / SAP / NetSuite), or PLM (Teamcenter) integration experience.</li> <li>Subsea robotics or AUV/UUV domain experience.</li> <li>AS9100 / ISO 9001 environments and the configuration-management discipline that comes with them.</li> <li>Embedded firmware — flashing, debugging, reading datasheets, talking to bootloaders.</li> <li>Experience integrating with hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V, hydraulics, compressed gas) — and the safety design that goes with it.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍 London or Barcelona | UK remote | 💰 £124,400 - 165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> — <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/data">Data</a></h4> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.</p> <p>At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</p> <p><em>Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</em></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!</p> <h4><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs</li> <li>Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes</li> <li>Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster</li> <li>Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks</li> <li>Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work</li> <li>Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> <li>You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk</li> <li>You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility</li> <li>You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Technical assessment</li> <li>Final Interviews <ul> <li>Business Fit/Collaboration</li> <li>Case Study</li> <li>Technical Interview</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/21/data-hiring-at-monzo">Data Hiring at Monzo</a>.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <p><strong>💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more - see our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>.</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we’ll make this happen whenever we can — whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Role Description All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve. Principal Accountabilities Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite. Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan. Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors. Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided. Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls. Personal Attributes & Experience Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships. You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending. You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers. You will be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work. You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance. You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications. You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk. You’ll demonstrate an ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information. #LI-Remote #LI-AD1 Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.
