title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create. Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week. 30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. Be part of a compensated on-call rotation Set the technical direction Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. What you need to succeed in this role Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today. Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack. Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation. A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change. A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation. Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems. Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone. Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it. A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone. Experience in using AI for engineering. Nice to haves Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production. Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations. Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it. Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security. Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry. Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching. title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description: Who we are and what you’ll do HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products. Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment. Main objectives of the role As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO. Your role and responsibilities Strategic Software Vision & Architecture : Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces. Execution & High-Stakes Delivery : Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams : Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers. Cross-Functional Alignment : Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways. Business-First Leadership : Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value. Operational Leadership & Partnering : Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction. AI Strategy & Development Workflows : Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use. What you need to succeed in this role Engineering Leadership : Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments Deep-Tech Literacy : Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services. Track Record of Ownership : Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management : Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders. Pragmatic Decision-Making : Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction. AI-Driven Development Strategy : Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows. Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user. We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate. description: <p><strong>ANINE BING</strong> is looking for an <strong>Accounting Manager </strong>to join our Finance team based in Paris.</p> <p>This role is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of ANINE BING. As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the Accounting Manager brings both strategic insight and hands-on execution to their work — supporting our global growth while staying grounded in the brand's DNA: refined, fast-moving, and always evolving.</p> <p>We're looking for a senior, hands-on accounting professional who thrives in a creative yet performance-driven environment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting expertise with a project management mindset, a genuine sensitivity to Finance × IT topics (AP automation, ERP improvements), and a structured, team-oriented approach. They are rigorous, organized, and energized by leading a team and building scalable accounting processes across an international footprint.</p> <p>Reporting to the Global Accounting Director, the Accounting Manager owns the day-to-day accounts payable and general accounting operations across our directly-managed entities — France, the UK, the US and other EU markets. The role manages a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, and Intern) and acts as the operational anchor of the accounting team, ensuring clean books, timely closes and strong vendor relationships. The role is expected to operate as a true business partner to all operational departments, not as a back-office function.</p> <p>This is a hybrid position based at our Paris HQ, with one remote day per week (Wednesday or Friday). The role reports to the Accounting & Tax Director.</p> <h3>Responsibilities Include:</h3> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across all directly-managed entities: vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payment runs, expense reports, and vendor relationship management.</li> <li>Lead the general accounting operations: journal entries, bank reconciliations, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany bookings — ensuring accurate, timely month-end and year-end closes.</li> <li>Manage and develop a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, Intern): set priorities, coach, review work and build technical depth within the team.</li> <li>Partner with the Accounting & Tax Director on the design and implementation of accounting policies, internal controls and process improvements.</li> <li>Lead Finance × IT initiatives within scope: AP automation tools, ERP improvements, expense management systems and approval workflows.</li> <li>Support statutory audits and tax filings by preparing required schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation across entities.</li> <li>Act as a true business partner to Operations, Procurement, Retail and HQ teams — building trust, anticipating needs and ensuring smooth vendor management.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements:</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of progressive experience in accounting, including at least 2 years managing a team of accountants in an international, multi-entity environment.</li> <li>Senior profile with a strong hands-on mindset: comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with direct, detailed accounting work.</li> <li>Strong technical command of French GAAP; It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . Mission Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount. The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite. and cost optimization across our stack 🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope 🩺 Health Professionals IT The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process 🌍 Internationalisation Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one Bring acquired entities onto that same platform Milestones First 3 months Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation First 6 months Own a workstream end-to-end Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end Take up documentation and automation on your scope and the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir vertraut. Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Zahlenaffinität als Muss: Echte Lust auf Dashboards und KPIs - Zahlen sind für dich Entscheidungsgrundlage, keine lästige Pflicht. Extreme Ownership: Kein Team, kein Vorgesetzter der dir alles vorgibt. Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist - du erkennst was gebraucht wird und machst es. description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong> </p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.</li> <li>An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.</li> <li>Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.</li> <li>Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.</li> <li>International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.</li> <li>Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.</li> <li>Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.</li> <li>Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.</li> <li>Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.</li> <li>Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.</li> <li>Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.</li> <li>Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.</li> <li>Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.</li> <li>Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.</li> <li>Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.</li> <li>Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.</li> <li>Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.</li> <li>Fluent English essential. title: Working Student/Intern - Marketing
description: At justDice, we create mobile gaming experiences that reward players for their time and engagement. We move quickly, take ownership, and value people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge how we do things. You’ll work with experienced teammates, solve meaningful problems, and have the freedom to make an impact from day one. Wir sind der europäische Marktführer im Bereich App-Discovery und Mobile Gaming. Mit einer Reichweite von Millionen an Nutzer:innen weltweit entwickeln, erwerben und skalieren wir Tech-Produkte, die begeistern. Wir arbeiten mit hoher Autonomie, hohem Tempo und ohne unnötigen Schnickschnack. Wenn du ein Konzernumfeld mit endlosen Freigabeschleifen suchst, bist du hier falsch. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen, mutige Ideen testen und deine Karriere in Marketing durchstarten möchtest, dann willkommen zu Hause! Wir suchen eine/n energiegeladen/n Werkstudenten/in oder Praktikanten/in (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Marketing Teams in den Bereichen Organic Content, Performance Marketing, SEO und Influencer Marketing. Deine Mission Organic & Social Growth: Erstelle frischen, trendbewussten Content für unsere Social-Media-Plattformen. Du weißt genau, was auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube funktioniert – und stehst vielleicht sogar selbst für unsere eigenen Kampagnen vor der Kamera. title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry. Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff. Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control. German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English. German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users. You take ownership and proactively push work forward. You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams. Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped. You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure. Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus. Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus. Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus. Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus. Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus. An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus. Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks. Potential to participate in the employee stock option program. Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program. A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Government Solutions (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO At LiveEO, we combine Space Technology with AI to solve problems here on Earth. Our satellite-based monitoring solutions help Infrastructure operators and industrial companies to make their operations more ecological, safer, and more efficient. LiveEO is applying the latest developments in artificial intelligence to analyse satellite data and is bringing the insights of earth observation data to customers in the enterprise sector. LiveEO’s ambitious goal is to monitor 1 billion assets across the globe with its unique SaaS solution until 2030. Our team is as global as the satellite data we process and the customers we serve. Together, we are building something big. Our Government team is growing fast: dedicated business development for Germany and for EU institutions, with more to come. What it doesn't have yet is marketing — the force multiplier. As our first dedicated Government marketing hire, you will build LiveEO's defence & government marketing from the ground up: positioning, content, PR and events, as a true generalist who owns the whole picture. Your challenge 1. Positioning & product marketing Own government/defence positioning, messaging and value propositions — resilience, situational awareness, ISR — across LiveEO's offering including our own satellite constellation, Twinspector Build and maintain the collateral suite: capability briefs, decks, one-pagers, materials supporting tenders and more Own the government presence on the LiveEO website and keep messaging sharp against competitor/peer positioning in the European defence-tech and EO landscape 2. Strategic communications, Content, PR & visibility Build and execute the strategic communications and content plan: white papers, expert articles, use-case stories Own press releases and announcements (contracts, partnerships, milestones) together with leadership Build relationships with defence, security and space trade media across Germany and Europe Drive executive visibility: LinkedIn presence, interviews, speaking opportunities for the Government leadership 3. Events Own the defence & government event calendar across Europe (e.g. AFCEA, Berlin Security Conference, ILA, Eurosatory, space/EO industry events and NATO-affiliated formats) Run participation end-to-end: selection and budget, booth/presence, speaking slots, briefing the BD team, structured lead follow-up 4. title: Customer Support Specialist - CDD 6 mois
description: Rejoignez l’aventure Joivy : L’art de vivre (et de travailler) à l’européenne ! Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie). Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis. Au sein de l'équipe Customer Care (Service Client), votre objectif est de maximiser la satisfaction client. Vous êtes le point de contact principal des clients tout au long de leur parcours, depuis le jour de leur réservation jusqu'au remboursement de leur dépôt de garantie après leur départ. Vous assistez les clients pour l'ensemble de leurs problématiques, qu'elles soient administratives ou financières, y compris pour la maintenance de leur appartement. La maîtrise des langues est essentielle, car une part importante de nos clients est internationale. La majorité de l'équipe est basée à Lyon, à l'exception d'une personne basée à Paris, et nous opérons à distance sur l'ensemble de nos villes en France. Vos missions : Gérer la relation et accompagner le client à distance via Zendesk tout au long de son expérience de coliving, de l'entrée à la sortie du logement : rédaction du bail, vérification des documents, organisation des états des lieux d'entrée ( check-in ) et de sortie ( check-out ), comparaison des états des lieux, remboursement des dépôts de garantie. Créer le dossier client numérique et le mettre à jour tout au long de son parcours. Gérer à distance les conflits entre colivers (colocataires) et les litiges clients, dans le meilleur intérêt de l'entreprise et du client. Recouvrer les impayés de loyers et les différents frais auprès des clients par e-mail et par téléphone. Résoudre les problèmes techniques (paiement, accès au compte client, etc.) rencontrés par le client en mobilisant les ressources de l'entreprise. Qualifier, transmettre et suivre en interne l'exécution des interventions techniques dans les appartements, et en informer le client. Assurer le suivi auprès des locataires concernant les interventions en cours ou à venir. Qualifier et répondre aux différents besoins et demandes des clients par e-mail, chat ou WhatsApp, dans les délais définis par l'entreprise. Contribuer à l'amélioration des pratiques et processus de Customer Happiness afin d'accroître la satisfaction client et d'optimiser les coûts opérationnels des logements en coliving : remonter les bugs à l'équipe technique, améliorer les flux de travail ( workflows ), numériser les processus, etc. Ton profil se distingue par : Diplômé(e) en gestion, commerce ou relations clients, tu justifies idéalement d'une première expérience réussie dans le secteur immobilier (gestion locative, transaction ou property management). Tu es un(e) communicant(e) hors pair. Tu sais allier empathie, clarté et fermeté pour instaurer un climat de confiance tout en défendant les intérêts de Joivy et de ses partenaires. Véritable "digital native", tu maîtrises les outils collaboratifs modernes (type Zendesk, CRM) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les modes de travail hybrides ou à distance. Tu ne te contentes pas de gérer l'existant. Ta proactivité et ton esprit d'analyse te poussent à identifier des axes d'amélioration et à proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser nos processus. Parce que nous savons que nos experts sont notre meilleure ressource, nous vous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant : Intégrez une communauté soudée et ultra-motivée pour relever des défis collectifs ! On ne s'ennuie jamais chez nous ! Entre nos afterwork, nos chasses aux œufs mémorables, ou nos incontournables petits-déjeuners du mardi, la convivialité est sacrée. La mutuelle performante de Swisslife avec de fortes garanties pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Des tickets restaurant de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), prise à 50% du titre de transport. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the analytical platforms used for the design and statistical analysis of clinical trial data. As a Business System Expert , you will act as the link between Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, IT, QA, and external vendors, ensuring the performance, compliance, and continuous improvement of critical clinical systems. Key Responsibilities Provide functional support and administration for analytical platforms, primarily SAS (Viya, Grid, Clinical) and related systems. Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey. Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission. title: Working Student Integrations Management (m/w/d)
description: Über Recare Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie. Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen. Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell rund 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter – und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen. Das erwartet dich bei uns Arbeit mit Purpose: Deine Tätigkeit hat einen positiven Einfluss auf Patient:innen, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen. Unternehmenskultur: Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam an unseren Zielen und erwarten dieses Engagement auch von dir. Flexibilität: Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen, sowie die Möglichkeit, zu 100 % remote zu arbeiten. Edenred-Karte: Du erhältst eine Edenred-Karte, die du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst. Zusätzlicher Urlaubstag: Damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst, hast du an diesem Tag frei. Deine Rolle als Working Student Integrations Management (m/w/d) Als Working Student Integrations Management (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser neunköpfiges Interoperability-&-Integrations-Team. Du konfigurierst unsere API-Gateways in den Krankenhäusern und stellst damit einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Darüber hinaus bearbeitest du eingehende Support-Tickets, identifizierst die Ursachen technischer Probleme und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden, dem First-Level-Support und dem Engineering-Team an der Lösung. Du behältst eingehende Support-Tickets zu unseren Integrationen im Blick, reproduzierst Fehler und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Lösung. Du überwachst unsere API-Gateways im laufenden Betrieb und analysierst technische Probleme – einschließlich Troubleshooting über Datadog. Bei tiefergehenden technischen Anliegen bist du eine zuverlässige Ansprechperson für unseren First-Level-Support. Du bildest die Schnittstelle zu unserem Engineering-Team, erstellst Bug-Tickets und informierst alle Beteiligten über den aktuellen Stand. Das bringst du mit als Working Student Integrations Management (m/w/d) Du studierst Informatik, Medizininformatik, Digital Health, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Fachrichtung. Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis: APIs, Datenformate sowie die Grundzüge von Softwarearchitektur und Deployment-Modellen wie Cloud, Hybrid und On-Premises sind dir nicht fremd. Din Growth Mindset zählt bei uns mehr als perfektes Vorwissen: Du arbeitest dich gerne selbstständig in neue technische Zusammenhänge ein, hast keine Angst vor Fehlern und gehst Probleme aktiv an, anstatt auf fertige Anleitungen zu warten. Du bist resilient und behältst auch bei kniffligen Kundenanfragen einen kühlen Kopf. Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden - telefonisch und per E-Mail - und bringst Empathie sowie Kompromissbereitschaft mit. Du organisierst dich selbstständig, holst dir aktiv Unterstützung, wenn du nicht weiterkommst, und arbeitest gerne in einem Remote-Team. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und fließende Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau. title: Training Operations Coordinator (m/f/d)
description: As a Training Operations Coordinator, you ensure that Quantum Systems' trainings and demo missions run smoothly. You coordinate training activities, manage UAV assets and equipment, maintain system readiness, and continuously improve the operational processes that enable our global training organization to scale. Working alongside our world-class team, you will not only support daily operations but actively shape how we scale and optimize our training setup. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders from Repair, Support, Production, Fulfilment, Software Engineering, and Marketing to deliver world-class trainings and outstanding demos. Beyond coordination, you will drive operational excellence by defining standards, improving processes, and managing internal initiatives to support Quantum Systems in becoming the benchmark for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). What is your Day to Day Mission: Training & Demo Operations - Coordinate and support UAV training courses and demo events from planning through execution. Organize schedules, participants, logistics, training materials, and operational readiness. Act as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders and training participants. Ensure smooth preparation and execution of all training and demonstration activities. UAV Fleet & Equipment Readiness - Manage the allocation, handover, return, and tracking of UAV systems, payloads, batteries, and accessories. Maintain training and demo systems in an operationally ready condition. Perform software and firmware updates and coordinate repairs, maintenance, and replacement equipment when required. Maintain inventory records and ensure equipment availability for upcoming activities. Process Improvement & Team Operations - Continuously improve training and demo processes, standards, and documentation. Support the implementation of workflows, automations, and digital tools to increase efficiency. Coordinate internal improvement initiatives and contribute to scaling the global training organization. Support creation and maintenance of operational procedures, training documentation, and reporting structures. Administrative & Compliance Support - Maintain training records, certifications, flight logs, and operational documentation. Support audits and ensure compliance with aviation and internal quality requirements.Assist with reporting, onboarding activities, and day-to-day administrative tasks. What you bring to the team: You have completed vocational training in a commercial, administrative, or operational field (e.g. office management, administration) or have equivalent practical experience. You bring at least 1–3 years of experience in operations, project coordination, training management, or a comparable role. You have a strong interest in process optimization, operational excellence, and improving how things work. You are structured, solution-oriented, and take ownership of topics, driving them forward independently. You enjoy combining operational coordination with hands-on work involving UAV systems and equipment. You know JIRA/Confluence or similar tools. Your open, communicative, and confident manner allows you to quickly establish yourself as a trusted internal point of contact. Fluent communication in German and English is a matter of course for you. This position requires a predominant activity on site in Gilching, as the support of our training and demo systems as well as the equipment can only be carried out directly at the site. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Du hast Spaß am direkten Vertrieb, der Umsetzung von Sales-Strategien und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen? Dann lies weiter. Das Unternehmen: Ein wachstumsstarkes, technologiegetriebenes Smart-City-Unternehmen mit einer Plattform für anbieterneutrale Paketstationen im DACH-Raum. Die Mission: Effiziente und nachhaltige Paketlogistik auf der letzten Meile. Als Regional Sales Manager bist du entscheidend beteiligt an der Expansion und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien in deiner Region. Deine Benefits Dich erwartet ein qualifikationsabhängiges Monatsbruttogehalt + monatlichen Bonus von durchschnittlich 1.800€. Ein Skoda Karoq für komfortable Firmenreisen steht für dich bereit. Work-Life-Balance UND Karriere : Dieser Arbeitgeber ermöglicht flexible Arbeitszeiten & eine selbstständige Organisation deines Alltags. Startup-Spirit, flache Hierarchien & Austausch auf Augenhöhe – sind hier nicht einfach so daher gesagt, sondern gelebte Kultur! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding erwartet dich, sodass du dich schnellstmöglich einlebst! Dich erwarten zahlreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Bikeleasing und EGYM Wellpass für deine Gesundheit. Events wie Firmenfeiern oder spontane Afterwork Meet Ups: für dich ist sicher etwas dabei . Ein modernes Tech Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du wünschst dir einen Benefit, der hier nicht aufgeführt ist? Dieser Arbeitgeber ist offen für deine Wünsche! 🔥 Deine Aufgaben als Area Sales Manager Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht in der Ansprache neuer B2B-Partner durch die Direktakquise im Außendienst. Dein Kunden-Portfolio umfasst dabei 3 Bereiche: Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, Tankstellen und Wohnungsbaugesellschaften. 🔍 Das heißt konkret: Du bist ca. 4 Tage pro Woche im Außendienst unterwegs inkls. 2 Übernachtungen. Von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss bist du für deine Kunden verantwortlich. Dabei erarbeitest du für deine regionalen Partner maßgeschneiderte Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung der lokalen Gegebenheiten. Außerdem repräsentierst du deinen Arbeitgeber auf regionalen Branchenveranstaltungen , Messen und Konferenzen . Last but not least: Du baust dein Netzwerk zu relevanten Kontakten in deiner Region . Du treibst durch deine Ideen & dein Verkaufstalent das rapide Wachstum deines Arbeitgebers weiter voran! Das bringst du mit Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Außendienst , idealerweise im Direktvertrieb/Flächenakquise. Erfahrung im Dienstleistungsvertrieb . Wohnsitz in einem der gesuchten Einsatzgebiete. Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und Kundenorientierung. Hands-on-Mentalität, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Fließendes Deutsch & Englisch von Vorteil, für Optimale Kommunikation mit Kunden im Team. Bereitschaft für regelmäßige Außendienstfahrten und Übernachtungen . Führerschein Klasse B . Du möchtest für einen Arbeitgeber arbeiten, der sich einer nachhaltigen Mission verschrieben hat? Es reizt dich, den weiteren Wachstumskurs aktiv mit zu gestalten? Dann sende uns noch heute deinen Lebenslauf. ✉️ Wir geben dir gern in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos & Insights zum Unternehmen und zur Stelle! title: Werkstudent IT Support (m/w/d)
description: Dein neues Team: Bist Du ein Problemlöser und hast Spaß daran, Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei technischen Fragen schnell und pragmatisch zu helfen? Als Werkstudent IT Support (m/w/d) unterstützt Du unser IT-Infrastructure-Team im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support und sorgst mit dafür, dass unser Arbeitsalltag reibungslos läuft. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team zusammen und unterstützt sowohl im Tagesgeschäft als auch bei Optimierungen rund um Microsoft 365 und unsere Inhouse-Infrastruktur. Das erwartet Dich: Erster Ansprechpartner: Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen im First Level Support zu Windows-Clients, macOS, Druckern, MS Office sowie gängigen Anwendungsprogrammen und bearbeitest Support-Anfragen strukturiert bis zur Lösung oder sinnvollen Eskalation. Onboarding Support: Du unterstützt das Helpdesk-Team beim Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender, richtest PC-Arbeitsplätze ein und stellst sicher, dass die Ausstattung pünktlich und einsatzbereit bereitsteht. Workplace Checks: Du prüfst IT-Arbeitsplätze auf Funktionalität, unterstützt bei Fehleranalysen und hilfst dabei, Standards für stabile Setups im Alltag umzusetzen. Prozess und Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt bei Projekten zur Prozess- und Infrastrukturoptimierung und bringst Dich bei Themen wie Stabilität, Nutzerzufriedenheit und Effizienz mit ein. Arbeitsmodell: Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Office in Düsseldorf und kommst idealerweise 2 bis 3 Mal pro Woche ins Büro. Das bringst Du mit: Immatrikulation: Du bist an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert. IT Grundlagen: Du bringst erweiterte Grundkenntnisse in IT-Systemen mit und hast idealerweise Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Inbetriebnahme von PC-Arbeitsplätzen mit Windows 11 und macOS. Peripherie Setup: Du kennst Dich mit der Einrichtung und dem Betrieb von Druckern und Scannern aus und gehst bei Störungen strukturiert vor. Office Know-how: Du verfügst über grundlegende Kenntnisse in gängigen Office-Anwendungen. Sprachen: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch in Wort und Schrift und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit. Das bringen wir mit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten : Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse! Flache Hierarchien : Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen. Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten : Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln. Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events : Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents. Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club : Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten! Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser : Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen. Rabatte über Corporate Benefits : Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel! You currently report to the CEO. This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers. Responsibilities Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory. Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity. Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews. Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do. Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption. Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts. Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base. Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork. title: Post-doctorant.e "Nouvelles méthodologies Auger pour l'analyse quantitative de la ségrégation interfaciale dans les aciers faiblement alliés" - CDD 24 mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés. Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux. Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail. Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène. Le deuxième axe de travail porte sur le développement d'un modèle quantitatif pour l'analyse par Auger de la ségrégation intergranulaire des éléments d'alliages. Il s'agira d'une approche similaire à celle déjà développée pour le phosphore et le soufre, avec la difficulté supplémentaire de soustraire la contribution du volume, ici non-négligeable. Les troisième et quatrième axes de ce post-doc s'appuient sur le spectromètre Auger installé en décembre 2025. Cet équipement de dernière génération présente une résolution latérale inférieure à 10 nm. Ceci ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyses que nous souhaitons explorer dans le cadre de la chaire, en particulier concernant l'analyse du carbone et des carbures, qui constitue le troisième axe de travail de ce post-doc. L'analyse Auger de la surface des carbures nanométriques devient possible avec le nouvel instrument et permet d'accéder à la composition chimique des interfaces carbures-matrice. De plus, l'analyse Auger des facettes intergranulaires pourra être faite en-dehors des carbures et permettra d'accéder à la quantification du carbone ségrégé dans le joint. Enfin, le dernier axe de travail consistera à développer une méthode de quantification de la ségrégation intergranulaire sans rupture. Il s’agira de travailler ici sur une coupe polie du matériau à étudier et à réaliser des analyses locales, par exemple des profils de concentrations à travers les joints de grains. Compte tenu de l'excellente résolution latérale, on peut ainsi espérer détecter la ségrégation par cette méthode. Une méthode de traitement des données devra être développée pour accéder à des concentrations intergranulaires de solutés. Une telle méthode a déjà été mise au point pour des analyses réalisées par nanoSIMS et pourrait être transposée sur la spectrométrie Auger. Elle permettrait de s’affranchir de la nécessité d'obtenir une rupture intergranulaire (particulièrement limitante en spectrométrie Auger), tout en conservant une préparation d’échantillon très simple (coupe polie) et une productivité potentiellement importante (grand nombre de joints analysables dans un échantillon donné). 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes : · Titulaire d'un doctorat en Sciences des Matériaux ou Physique ou Chimie Vous êtes doté(e) des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes : · Bonne connaissance de la science des matériaux · Expérience en microscopie électronique en transmission Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes : · Capacité à travailler en équipe · Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! title: Video Systems Engineer
description: YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do. THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Video Systems Engineer to operate the technical backbone behind our content delivery — for linear TV channels and video-on-demand. You will manage systems and configurations to ensure seamless processes from ingestion to delivery. In this deeply operational role, you will work on all video content available on the Zattoo platform and collaborate with teams from different departments like Product, Content, and Data Center to ensure the best experience for our users and tenants. THE VIDEO OPERATIONS TEAM You'll join the team responsible for everything between the satellite dish and the viewer's screen — headend operations, satellite and IP ingest, encoding, and channel configuration across our entire live TV lineup. WHAT YOU’LL DO Configure new and maintain existing linear TV channels on the Zattoo platform, including capabilities like catch-up, subtitles, HbbTV Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on channel acquisition to ensure a fast integration and smooth operations Own and maintain our DVB-S headends in close collaboration with the data center team, configuring FTA and encrypted satellite ingests and planning needed capacities Coordinate the integration of IP signal providers, plan topics like bandwidth, redundancy, and other technical parameters, or via SRT, ZiXi, and similar Support the VOD ingestion process Configure and manage the different server pools, which are used for encoding and transcoding Procure, configure and maintain all the professional equipment and software Maintain configuration and document relevant specifications to have easy access to a catalogue of channels existing on the platform Diagnose and resolve faults across the signal chain Support monitoring, alerting and incident response WHAT YOU’LL BRING Hands-on experience configuring, managing and maintaining linear TV channels on a broadcast or streaming platform Solid understanding of the DVB standards, satellite fundamentals, as well as standards such as MPEG-TS Experience configuring and maintaining professional satellite receivers and IRDs (e.g. Teleste, AppearTV). Practical knowledge of encoding and transcoding - encoding parameters, audio track handling and subtitle integration. Familiarity with low-latency ingest protocols such as SRT and Zixi. Comfortable with structured fault diagnosis, also under pressure Good communication skills Bonus: Scripting skills in Python or Bash for automation Knowledge of FAST channels and SCTE-35 markers Familiarity with IP multicast and content protection, or a genuine interest and understanding of the TV and broadcast industry landscape WHY JOIN US? At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all. WHAT WE OFFER YOU Reward : strong market competitive salary Recharge : 30 days vacation plus public holidays Regulate :trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year Plus: We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days **We’re inclusive: ‘**Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more! We’re mobile: discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.
