title: Senior System Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, TX or Seattle, WA</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.</li> <li>You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.</li> <li>You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. You’re familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.</li> <li>You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.</li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing.</li> <li>You’ve contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries.</li> <li>Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>We build products at the intersection of AI, search and retrieval, data insights, and product engineering.</p> <p>As AI agents change how people discover and interact with the Internet, new problems are emerging around how content is found, understood, retrieved, and kept current. Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to help website owners make their content discoverable and to help agents find relevant, trustworthy information across our network. Building these capabilities requires solving problems across distributed systems, crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval quality, developer experience, and reliable product delivery.</p> <p>Cloudflare also has a unique perspective on how the Internet is changing. We need to deliver excellent products today while continuing to identify the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead engineering across some of our AI and Internet Data Insights portfolio.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that help customers make their content discoverable and turn complex Internet signals into useful experiences. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. team working across several related technical areas and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that people use to understand the Internet.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, search systems, data-intensive systems, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.</li> correctness, reliability, and quality matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in English and Turkish (written and spoken).</li> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal levelling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. The Enterprise Account team will shape and lead Cloudflare’s Go To Market.</li> <li>We will leverage the strength of all Cloudflare functions to become a strategic partner to our customers and their digital transformation efforts. Our product and services and our methods of engagement will differentiate and delight our customers.</li> <li>The AE will interact with both C-level clients and senior technical decision makers, utilizing Cloudflare solutions and resources to drive a business partnership focused on joint success with our customers.  Success requires consultative, solutions-oriented sales, and customer service skills in addition to intense personal energy and focused activity. A critical factor of achievement in this role is the ability and desire to focus and lead an internal group of constituents to bring their skillset to bear to build solutions and exponentially grow revenue. The AE must be expert in identifying business opportunities with customers, developing Enterprise Account Plans, driving execution across functional stakeholders, and closing revenue. The Enterprise Account Executive should be comfortable engaging in business level outcome conversations with the C-suite, presenting Cloudflare’s vision and plan for value creation to all levels, and negotiating win-win scenarios for all parties. The AE will be accountable to obtaining new business and expansion of Cloudflare wallet-share within existing customers. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources. Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.</li> </ul> <h3>Enterprise Account Team Core Values:</h3> <ul> <li>Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Have a plan for “how” you’ll hit your goals and evaluate often; that way you always know where you stand. Be in a position and ready to demonstrate your plan for success.</li> <li>Provide Customers with a Premium Business Experience - Solutions, Empathy, Proactiveness, Anticipation of needs, Company Support, Creativity, and Urgency to Deliver Value are core principles of a Cloudflare Strategic Account Experience. Give your customers a level of service that is unmatched in the industry.</li> <li>Be Brilliant in the Basics - The hallmark of a high performance team is their willingness to commit to Brilliance in the Basics in all aspects of their roles. Forecasting, SFDC Disciplines, Pipeline Management, Account Engagement, Negotiation, Closing, and Depth of Cloudflare Knowledge are the basic skills that make a Strategic Account Executive successful.</li> <li>Make Bold Decisions - Operating with the largest companies in the world is a “game of inches”. If execution presents risk, Seek the advice of leaders when and where you need it.</li> <li>Teammate - We are all individually accountable to our goals, but we operate as a team. accounts prior to formal form fills.</li> <li><strong>Shorter Sales Cycles & Increased Pipeline Velocity:</strong> Measurably reduce conversion timelines through automated lead prioritization and streamlined handoff workflows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>7–10 years of experience</strong> bridging B2B marketing operations with systems The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. title: Business Operations & Strategy
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion’s Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, & Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis. In this role, you’ll work hand-in-hand with leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Build trusted relationships with cross-functional leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value to our users and our business - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building detailed business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work - Develop a comprehensive understanding of our competitive positioning by using, assessing, and developing insights about peer businesses to inform your recommendations - Deeply understand Notion customers and the broader market landscape to uncover insights that inform your recommendations - Create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them SKILLS YOU'LL BRING - 5+ years of strategy experience, including 2+ years of experience in management consulting or a related field - Excellent quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the attention to detail and quality bar required for decisions that affect products and the business - Outstanding executive-level written and verbal communication skills; can operate independently with senior stakeholders and manage relationships, deliverables, and timelines with minimal supervision - Genuine enthusiasm for and proficiency with AI tools; we use AI across the board to move faster and work smarter, and you do too - Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools such as Notion AI, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar; you actively experiment with new models and workflows and use judgment to apply them responsibly - Data self-sufficiency, including working knowledge of SQL and the ability to access, assess, and synthesize relevant data without relying on outside support - Comfort working in a high-growth, constantly changing environment with passion and enthusiasm NICE TO HAVES - Prior experience in strategy and operations in B2B SaaS businesses - Experience with pricing & packaging, especially for AI products Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. title: HR Generalist
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <h3><strong>We are hiring an HR Generalist to support our growing team</strong> </h3> <p>With 1,200+ colleagues across 75​ ​countries, we require an HR function that thinks and acts globally.​ We're looking for an HR Generalist who will report into our Regional HR Manager who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will demonstrate a high work ethic and the personal confidence to set and defend high expectations of colleagues, counterparts and processes. You must be able to work independently, take a hands-on approach, and interface effectively with professionals at all levels. You'll need excellent communication, professional and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to function in a proactive, innovative environment. We look to HR both to support our colleagues in their personal needs and development, and also to maintain consistently high standards across multiple teams, managers and directors.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>The role entails the individual to:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Provide HR guidance to team members and managers, setting high expectations of behaviour and performance.</li> <li>Partner with line managers to provide employee relations advice on global policies and procedures.</li> <li>Ensure accuracy and timeliness in processing employee changes, joiners and leavers.</li> <li>Manage and drive benefit programs spanning either our EMEA (UK, Ireland, France, Germany and Spain) or AMER (US, Canada and Brazil) locations</li> <li>Liaise with our finance team on monthly payroll, projects and enquiries.</li> <li>Support the full life-cycle of HR including onboarding, benefit administration, and departure.</li> <li>Apply critical thinking to automate and reduce administrative tasks.</li> <li>Take a lead role in the management, continued development, and integration of our HR system.</li> <li>Act as a system expert and advocate for the global HR team.</li> <li>Produce data driven reports to inform and influence HR initiatives.</li> <li>Lead and participate in projects where you’ll see the impact of your work.</li> <li>Support internal resource groups to drive initiatives such as diversity and inclusion.</li> <li>Create, update and maintain corporate policies that have a global lens with local application.</li> <li>Ensure consistency of application of our HR policies and procedures.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Relevant professional qualification and certifications.</li> <li>Excellent practical insights into either EMEA or AMER HR practices and employment laws.</li> <li>Self-directed, organised problem solver with the ability to prioritise and meet goals and deadlines. </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, sound judgement, tact and diplomacy in all communications.</li> <li>Fearless and principled approach to professional interactions at every level of the business with commitment to confidentiality of sensitive information.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events, with at least one trip of two full working weeks.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Annual compensation review.</li> <li>Recognition rewards.</li> <li>Annual holiday leave.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Product Marketing Lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p><strong>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</strong></p> <p>Product marketers at Canonical sit between product and the market. They take deeply technical open source products and decide what they mean to a user and a buyer; which problem they solve, who should care, why we win, and what it should cost. That work shows up as positioning and messaging, launch plans, competitive intelligence, global campaigns, and the enablement that helps sales tell a coherent story.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who wants ownership rather than a brief. You will pick up a portfolio area, form your own point of view on the market, and defend it with evidence. We expect product marketers to talk to customers and community members directly, and to bring opinions to product and sales rather than waiting to be told what to say.</p> <p>We have a bias for action, focus effort on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.</p> <p>Location: This role is remote for anyone based in EMEA.</p> <h2>The role entails</h2> <p>You will own product marketing for one of our product areas, from the market thesis through to the assets that sales and campaigns run on. You will be accountable for whether the story lands, whether launches convert, and whether the sales team can repeat the message without you in the room.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Own positioning, messaging, and the narrative hierarchy for your product area, and keep it consistent from the website through to the sales deck</li> <li>Lead product launches end to end with tiering, timeline, cross-functional plan, assets, and post-launch reporting</li> <li>Build and maintain the competitive picture for your area: who we lose to, why, and what we say about it</li> <li>Support building the enablement that sales actually uses: battlecards, discovery questions, objection handling, demo narratives</li> <li>Run structured customer and community research, including win-loss, to keep the messaging grounded in real language rather than internal assumptions</li> <li>Partner with demand generation, content, web, and events to turn positioning into campaigns that move pipeline</li> <li>Raise the standard of the craft around you through review, mentoring, and shared frameworks</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication in English</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university</li> <li>Proven product marketing experience in B2B software, SaaS, or open source</li> <li>A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a product or portfolio, not just executing someone else's</li> <li>Evidence of launches you led that changed a business outcome such as adoption, pipeline, or win rate</li> <li>The technical curiosity to hold your own with product managers and engineers and to understand the product beyond the datasheet</li> <li>Comfort using data to test a hypothesis, evaluate a campaign, and change your mind</li> <li>Ability to influence and align stakeholders across product, sales, and marketing without formal authority</li> <li>Excellent storytelling skills applied to technical solutions, for both developer and executive audiences</li> <li>Skill at managing complex, cross-functional projects with several dependencies and a fixed date</li> <li>Fast adaptation to change and to new technology in marketing</li> <li>Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident operating independently at a global scale</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience marketing to developers, or in infrastructure, security, or IoT categories</li> <li>Familiarity with open source communities and commercial open source business models</li> <li>Experience across both product-led and sales-led motions, and with the handover between them</li> <li>Public speaking, webinars, or conference presence in a technical field</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading other product marketers</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

Have a plan for “how” you’ll hit your goals and evaluate often; that way you always know where you stand. If execution presents risk, Seek the advice of leaders when and where you need it.</li> <li>Teammate - We are all individually accountable to our goals, but we operate as a team. No one person has all the answers, but collectively the knowledge, experience, and acumen of the team is deep. Be the person who actively seeks to assist the team, shares knowledge, and extends your personal network. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.</li> <li>Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.</li> <li>Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.</li> <li>Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.</li> <li>Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasts and report to the sales leader on the status of New and Expansion opportunities for weekly sales meetings. Leverage MEDDPIC framework in SFDC document weekly progress.</li> <li>Accountable to reverse closure steps and establish jointly owned timelines with Customers. Understand the purchasing process fully and be able to document progress against required steps to closure.</li> <li>Organize and deliver executive level presentations, proposals, commercial terms with Customers.</li> <li>Leverage the Executive Briefing Center and process to establish key sponsorships and support of accounts with Cloudflare Executives.</li> <li>Build and maintain relationships with channel partners to establish joint value propositions and Customer value.</li> <li>Participate in team meetings and deliver GTM guidance on how to better partner with accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>This is a remote role but the location requirement is that you reside in the DC Metro area</strong></li> <li>6+ years of experience coupled with proficiency in Cloud Networking and Security Technology with industry awareness.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of meeting and exceeding quota.</li> <li>Expert Sales Acumen (Discovery, Position, Compete, Negotiate, Close, Expand).</li> <li>Ability to lead a multidisciplinary team over a long term account horizon.</li> <li>Able to identify key players in organizations and possess the ability to convert business issues into solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable selling to obtain new business or expand existing business. Strong closing skills are essential.</li> <li>Ability to build meaningful relationships quickly.</li> <li>Someone who acts with integrity and honesty in all situations.</li> <li>Be able to demonstrate a positive attitude internally and externally.</li> <li>Expert at building rapport and owning the room.</li> <li>Aggressiveness in execution and planning.</li> <li>Ability to take successes and challenges in stride.</li> <li>Discipline to work w/o instant gratification.</li> <li>Someone who is bold in their actions and never satisfied with complacency.</li> <li>A strong will and fortitude to work a plan in the face of challenge.</li> <li>A business professional who loves the sales profession.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <h4>For Washington DC, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $269,000 - title: Engineering Manager - Python and K8s
location: Home Based - APAC; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Engineering Manager - Python and K8s</strong> that is passionate about building a world-class devops culture in corporate information systems. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productise those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes.</p> <p>As an engineering manager you’ll lead a team in your local time zone, focused on the business workloads that make Ubuntu, Canonical, and our various services highly available around the planet.You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team focused on productising business workloads</li> <li>You will build and manage a regional team of engineers</li> <li>You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring, and feedback</li> <li>You will demonstrate sound engineering by directly contributing toward your team’s goals</li> <li>Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement</li> <li>Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders</li> <li>Advance modern, agile software development practices</li> <li>Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence</li> <li>Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values</li> <li>Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation</li> <li>Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You have experience in Docker and Kubernetes operations</li> <li>You have a software engineering background, with proven Python experience</li> <li>You have experience developing Python frameworks, and understand the importance of stable consumable APIs</li> <li>You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible</li> <li>You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere</li> <li>You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it</li> <li>You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development</li> <li>You have experience working in an agile development environment</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <p> </p>

improvements</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical designs and lead projects across team boundaries</li> <li>Willingness to use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development and investigation while remaining accountable for correctness, security, and design quality</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Have Skills</h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience with Rust or high-performance asynchronous systems</li> <li>Experience with caches, HTTP proxies, CDNs, distributed storage, or latency-sensitive data-plane services</li> <li>Experience analyzing memory use, disk I/O, resource contention, and tail latency in production systems</li> <li>Experience building APIs or distributed control planes using event streaming, relational databases, or analytical data systems</li> <li>Familiarity with Kubernetes, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or similar infrastructure</li> <li>Experience contributing to open-source software or leading multi-team engineering programs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>San Francisco Estimated Base title: Senior Customer Engineer, Majors - NYC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Location: New York, US</h2> <p><strong>About Us</strong><br>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong><br>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong><br>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong><br>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tie

This role demands a unique combination of high-level strategic vision, a passion for experimentation, creativity, and a relentless commitment to world-class physical execution.</p> <p>First and foremost, you are a builder of impactful, high-performance spaces. You will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design and construction of workspaces that serve as the tangible, physical manifestation of the local Cloudflare culture.</p> <p>At the same time, you are stepping into uncharted territory. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Your creativity, physical hospitality, and human judgment will guide every project, ensuring our global spaces continuously evolve alongside our teams.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Physical Execution & Cultural Identity:</strong> Lead the physical realization of Cloudflare’s global offices. Direct architects, general contractors, and artists to design and build spaces that authentically capture the vibe and culture of each local hub, ensuring every environment feels uniquely Cloudflare, inspiring, and functional.</li> <li><strong>Conceptualize and execute the AI Workflow:</strong> Think outside the box to architect how AI and automation can revolutionize legacy design and construction phases. Map out and execute opportunities to eliminate manual bottlenecks across the entire project lifecycle - including vendor onboarding/benchmarking, contracting, cost estimation, budget/project tracking, and risk identification - by implementing automated review pipelines and data-driven quality controls.</li> <li><strong>Drive Spatial Experimentation:</strong> Treat our workplaces as living laboratories. Conceptualize and implement pioneering internal qualitative and quantitative data-collection methods - such as tracking real-time utilization patterns and capturing continuous employee feedback loops - to architect data-driven proposals that evolve our global footprints based on your findings.</li> <li><strong>Evolve the Design Framework:</strong> Use data insights and post-occupancy metrics to constantly challenge existing design assumptions. Lead formal change management efforts to iterate on our physical footprints and champion a generative design-supported “kit of parts” for global serviced offices, ensuring they fluidly adapt as work styles and distributed team needs change.</li> <li><strong>Predictive Capital & Site Strategy:</strong> Collaborate with Real Estate and FP&A teams to direct predictive modeling concepts for site selection, due diligence, project cash flows, long-term financial reporting, and financial risk mitigation, steering the department toward highly optimized capital allocation.</li> <li><strong>CapEx Budget Ownership & Financial Governance:</strong> Own and manage the global capital expenditure (CapEx) budget, delivering accurate multi-year financial forecasting, cost-variance reporting, and executive-level capital reporting.</li> <li><strong>Executive Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> Serve as the strategic bridge and primary liaison between internal executive business customers and external delivery partners (including architects, GCs, and furniture dealers). Ensure Physical Security, IT, Legal, and Workplace leadership are deeply aligned under a unified, technology-supported project pipeline and data layer that prioritizes the employee experience.</li> <li><strong>Lifecycle Handover & Commissioning:</strong> Establish rigorous commissioning protocols to ensure flawless handovers from construction completion to local Workplace Operations  teams.</li> <li><strong>Global Pipeline Governance & Compliance:</strong> Oversee a global project pipeline across all international hubs and time zones, seamlessly balancing highly creative local refreshes with complex, large-scale 100,000+ square foot tenant improvement projects. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - title: Engineering Manager, Browser Run
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Team</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We build the tooling and platform capabilities that power the next generation of AI agents on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. You will be expected to understand it well enough to review a design document, challenge an architecture, and know when an estimate is wrong.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What you’ll do</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Manage, coach and grow the team of systems engineers behind Browser Run — 1:1s, career development, performance conversations, and hiring.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the Browser Run roadmap and delivery, and give the team and the wider organisation clear visibility into what is being worked on, in what order, and what we are deliberately not doing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with Product Management to set direction: shape the roadmap, pressure-test scope, and make the trade-off calls that keep an incubation product shipping.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own Browser Run’s operational health — browser fleet capacity, session reliability, cold-start latency, concurrency limits, on-call rotations, alert quality and incident follow-through. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have run an engineering team that shipped, and you can point at what it shipped.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You give your technical legos away. Your measure of success is the team’s output and the growth of the people on it, not your own commit history.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are comfortable with ambiguity. Incubation means the requirements move, and you can change direction without drama.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are direct. You give feedback early, disagree openly, and admit when you were wrong.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You write well. You believe a clear design document, roadmap or incident report is as much of a deliverable as the code.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You care about operational quality and treat a noisy alert as a bug, not as background noise.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You find browsers genuinely interesting as an engineering problem — how Chrome behaves under load, why automation breaks, and what an AI agent actually needs from a browser it does not own.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You want to join a team that upholds a culture of support, open and honest communication, and collaborative problem-solving.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">2+ years managing engineering teams, on top of a solid track record as a hands-on engineer.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience owning a production service end to end, including on-call rotation, capacity planning and incident review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated experience growing engineers — promotions you supported, and ideally a team lead or first-line manager you developed.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on familiarity with browser automation — Chrome DevTools Protocol, Puppeteer or Playwright — or with the browser internals underneath them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web platform fundamentals (HTTP, JavaScript execution models, rendering) or cloud infrastructure — enough to hold a credible design review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><

PR, and communications teams to amplify intelligence content, manage workloads and deadlines, and develop a cohesive security narrative</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience in a threat intelligence role within the Five Eyes (FVEY) community</li> <li>7+ years of combined experience across technical actor groups, their operations, and TTPs</li> <li>Experience with OSINT research and intelligence collection methodologies</li> <li>Background in intelligence or criminal investigation reporting</li> <li>Experience working in a threat intelligence or security operations center (SOC) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated operational security (OPSEC) awareness and experience with the secure handling of sensitive information</li> <li>Strong research, proofreading, and editing skills with a keen attention to detail</li> <li>Experience communicating with internal teams to negotiate suggested changes to edited content and answer questions on style, grammar, and voice</li> <li>Strong collaboration and leadership skills to work with analysts, marketing, design, and PR teams to coordinate workloads, deadlines, and responsibilities</li> <li>Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Proficiency in using Google Suite and content management systems (e.g., WordPress, Jira, or similar workflow tools)</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience using AI and large language model (LLM) tools to accelerate research, drafting, editing, and intelligence production workflows</li> <li>Experience leading or managing a team of threat intelligence technical writers</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC GCTI, or similar cybersecurity credentials</li> <li>A portfolio of published, public-facing threat intelligence (bylined reports, advisories, or blog posts)</li> <li>Experience presenting threat research at industry conferences (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, RSA, FIRST, or SANS CTI Summit)</li> <li>Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and structured threat-sharing standards</li> </ul> <p>If Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources.
